title: 工作灯必须手持而非夹在套装上，导致照明不便。
description: 工作灯必须手持而非夹在套装上，导致照明不便。
evidence: Too dark to see? Turn on your worklight. It's still too dark. Why? Because the light needs to be held, not clipped to your suit.
